title.purpose: Name of the play history screen and its sidebar entry.
title.where: Sidebar, and the heading of the History screen.

import.choose.purpose: Button that opens the file dialog to import an m3u8 playlist exported from rekordbox's History as one set.

import.filter.purpose: Name of the file type filter in the file dialog (m3u8 and m3u files).
import.filter.where: File dialog opened from the History screen's import button.

import.hint.purpose: Explains where the m3u8 file comes from and that each file is one set.
import.hint.where: History screen, under the import button.

import.done_one.purpose: Says an m3u8 file was imported: how many plays, and how many matched a track the user has (one play).

import.done_other.purpose: Says an m3u8 file was imported: how many plays, and how many matched a track the user has.

import.skippedLines_one.purpose: Says how many lines of the imported file couldn't be read (one line). The import still happened.
import.skippedLines_one.where: History screen, after an import with unreadable lines.

import.skippedLines_other.purpose: Says how many lines of the imported file couldn't be read. The import still happened.
import.skippedLines_other.where: History screen, after an import with unreadable lines.

refusal.fileUnreadable.purpose: The picked file couldn't be read; nothing was imported.

refusal.fileTooBig.purpose: The picked file is over the 5 MB limit; nothing was imported.

refusal.noPlays.purpose: The picked file names no track; nothing was imported.

refusal.alreadyImported.purpose: The file holds the same tracks in the same order as a set already imported, so it was not imported again.

refusal.noSuchSession.purpose: The set the user acted on was removed meanwhile (for example by Undo).
refusal.noSuchSession.where: History screen, after changing a set.

refusal.badDate.purpose: The date the user typed for a set isn't a real calendar day.
refusal.badDate.where: History screen, after saving a set's date.

sessions.label.purpose: Accessible name of the list of imported sets.

sessions.none.purpose: Shown when no set has been imported yet; says how to get one.
sessions.none.where: History screen, list of sets, when empty.

sessions.summary_one.purpose: Line under a set's name: the day it was played, how many plays (one), how many matched a track the user has.
sessions.summary_one.where: History screen, each set in the list.

sessions.summary_other.purpose: Line under a set's name: the day it was played, how many plays, how many matched a track the user has.
sessions.summary_other.where: History screen, each set in the list.

plays.label.purpose: Accessible name of the chosen set's plays.
plays.label.where: History screen, plays of the chosen set.

plays.choose.purpose: Asks the user to pick a set to see its plays.
plays.choose.where: History screen, when no set is chosen.

plays.track.purpose: A play as the file named it: artist, then title.
plays.track.where: History screen, each play of the chosen set.

plays.notOwned.purpose: Marks a play that matched no track the user has (a partner's track, or a file not in the music folders).
plays.notOwned.where: History screen, next to such a play.

plays.date.purpose: Label of the field that corrects the day a set was played.
plays.date.where: History screen, above the chosen set's plays.

plays.saveDate.purpose: Button that saves the corrected date of a set (undoable).
plays.saveDate.where: History screen, next to the date field.

wishlist.label.purpose: Label of the choice of wishlist to add the set's unmatched tracks to.
wishlist.label.where: History screen, chosen set, while wishlists are on.

wishlist.add.purpose: Button that adds the set's plays the user doesn't have to the chosen wishlist, in one undoable step.
wishlist.add.where: History screen, chosen set, while wishlists are on.

wishlist.noLists.purpose: Shown instead of the add button when the user has no wishlist yet.
wishlist.noLists.where: History screen, chosen set, while wishlists are on.

wishlist.openWishlists.purpose: Link to the Wishlists screen, to make a list.
wishlist.openWishlists.where: History screen, chosen set, when there is no wishlist.

wishlist.added_one.purpose: Says how many tracks were added to the wishlist (one).
wishlist.added_one.where: History screen, after adding to a wishlist.

wishlist.added_other.purpose: Says how many tracks were added to the wishlist.
wishlist.added_other.where: History screen, after adding to a wishlist.

wishlist.skipped_one.purpose: Says how many unmatched plays weren't added because the file gave no artist or title (one).
wishlist.skipped_one.where: History screen, after adding to a wishlist.

wishlist.skipped_other.purpose: Says how many unmatched plays weren't added because the file gave no artist or title.
wishlist.skipped_other.where: History screen, after adding to a wishlist.

stick.label.purpose: Accessible name of the gig-stick import area.
stick.label.where: History screen, below the m3u8 import.

stick.choose.purpose: Button that opens the folder dialog to pick a gig stick's top folder and read its history lists.
stick.choose.where: History screen, below the m3u8 import.

stick.hint.purpose: Tells the user to close rekordbox before reading a stick (ROADMAP §5.4), to pick the stick's top folder, and that the stick is only read.
stick.hint.where: History screen, under the gig-stick button.

stick.list_one.purpose: One history list found on the stick, with its number of plays (one play), next to a checkbox.
stick.list_one.where: History screen, after a stick is read.

stick.list_other.purpose: One history list found on the stick, with its number of plays, next to a checkbox.
stick.list_other.where: History screen, after a stick is read.

stick.noLists.purpose: Says the stick was read but has no history lists.
stick.noLists.where: History screen, after a stick is read.

stick.date.purpose: Label of the date the ticked lists were played; defaults to today.
stick.date.where: History screen, under the stick's lists.

stick.import.purpose: Button that imports the ticked lists, each as one set.
stick.import.where: History screen, under the stick's lists.

stick.done_one.purpose: Says how many sets a stick import made (one set).
stick.done_one.where: History screen, after a stick import.

stick.done_other.purpose: Says how many sets a stick import made.
stick.done_other.where: History screen, after a stick import.

stick.unmatched_one.purpose: Says how many imported plays matched no track (one); they're kept.
stick.unmatched_one.where: History screen, after a stick import.

stick.unmatched_other.purpose: Says how many imported plays matched no track; they're kept.
stick.unmatched_other.where: History screen, after a stick import.

stick.alreadyImported_one.purpose: Says how many ticked lists were left out because the same plays are already a set on that date (one).
stick.alreadyImported_one.where: History screen, after a stick import.

stick.alreadyImported_other.purpose: Says how many ticked lists were left out because the same plays are already a set on that date.
stick.alreadyImported_other.where: History screen, after a stick import.

stick.skipped_one.purpose: Says how many damaged parts of the stick's database (pages, rows, entries) were skipped (one). The rest was read.
stick.skipped_one.where: History screen, after a stick is read or imported.

stick.skipped_other.purpose: Says how many damaged parts of the stick's database (pages, rows, entries) were skipped. The rest was read.
stick.skipped_other.where: History screen, after a stick is read or imported.

stick.refusal.noExport.purpose: The picked folder has no PIONEER\rekordbox\export.pdb.
stick.refusal.noExport.where: History screen, after picking a stick folder.

stick.refusal.unreadable.purpose: The stick's export.pdb is there but couldn't be read or copied.
stick.refusal.unreadable.where: History screen, after picking a stick folder or importing.

stick.refusal.tooBig.purpose: The stick's export.pdb is over the 256 MB limit.
stick.refusal.tooBig.where: History screen, after picking a stick folder.

stick.refusal.notAnExport.purpose: The stick's export.pdb doesn't look like a rekordbox export database.
stick.refusal.notAnExport.where: History screen, after picking a stick folder.

stick.refusal.nothingChosen.purpose: Import was asked for with no ticked list that has plays.
stick.refusal.nothingChosen.where: History screen, after a stick import.

stick.refusal.badDate.purpose: The date given for a stick import isn't a calendar day.
stick.refusal.badDate.where: History screen, after a stick import.

stick.plays_one.purpose: Says how many plays a stick import brought in (one) and how many matched a track by having the same audio (the stick holds its own copies, so plays are matched by content, not file path).
stick.plays_one.where: History screen, after a stick import.

stick.plays_other.purpose: Says how many plays a stick import brought in and how many matched a track by having the same audio (the stick holds its own copies, so plays are matched by content, not file path).
stick.plays_other.where: History screen, after a stick import.

stick.ambiguous_one.purpose: Says how many plays (one) were left unmatched because their audio is that of several tracks.
stick.ambiguous_one.where: History screen, after a stick import.

stick.ambiguous_other.purpose: Says how many plays were left unmatched because their audio is that of several tracks.
stick.ambiguous_other.where: History screen, after a stick import.

stick.unreadableFiles_one.purpose: Says how many plays (one) were left unmatched because their file on the stick couldn't be read (missing, too big, unreadable).
stick.unreadableFiles_one.where: History screen, after a stick import.

stick.unreadableFiles_other.purpose: Says how many plays were left unmatched because their file on the stick couldn't be read (missing, too big, unreadable).
stick.unreadableFiles_other.where: History screen, after a stick import.
